subtitle: Housewarming
welcomeMessage:
Welcome to República da Brisinha! 🌿🐾

Surrounded by plants, pots and pans, and countless stories, we're creating our own little haven, named in loving memory of our beloved dog, Brisinha.

And you're part of our story, too.
description:
We've put together a gift registry for anyone who'd like to contribute. Every little gesture means a lot to us, no matter how far away you are.

Long live República da Brisinha!
